title: The Case of the Scorpion's Tail
writer: Eduardo Manzanos, Ernesto Gastaldi, Sauro Scavolini
actors: George Hilton, Anita Strindberg, Alberto de Mendoza
plot: An investigator seeks to determine the legitimacy of a life insurance payout being made to a heiress in the wake of her husband's death, but he soon finds himself suspected of her murder.
